_comment: A behaviour, not a visual — the Lark Standard's `helper` category. IntersectionObserver on a sentinel div after the children; no variants, no states, no tokens. Registered so the library owns the behaviour the Frontend repeats in 3 places.

_verified_from.scope: token mirror searched for infinit/scroll; frontend common/infinity-scroll read in full
_verified_from.result: VERIFIED ABSENT in Figma, correctly — a helper has nothing to draw. Frontend is the authority for the behaviour: observe a sentinel, call loadMore when it intersects and hasMore && !loading.
